landing.heroTitle: Run your whole restaurant from one software
landing.heroSubtitle: POS billing, kitchen, inventory, delivery and accounts — FoodX brings your restaurant's daily work into one place, on your own domain.
landing.demoLoginNote: This is a public demo account — feel free to look around. Demo data may change at any time.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything a restaurant needs, in one place
landing.posBody: Fast counter billing with tables, waiters and payments by cash, card, bKash or Nagad.
landing.kitchenBody: Orders reach the kitchen instantly and move step by step from preparation to ready.
landing.inventoryBody: Ingredients, recipes, purchases and stock levels — know what you have and what things cost.
landing.orderingBody: Customers order from your own website on your own domain — your orders, your customers.
landing.deliveryBody: Delivery zones, fees and drivers, tracked from dispatch to delivered.
landing.businessBody: Daily expenses, cashier shifts, day closing and a live profit & loss view.
landing.reportsBody: Sales, top items and payment breakdowns — today's picture at a glance.
landing.languageBody: The whole panel works in Bangla and English, on phone, tablet or computer.
landing.step1Title: We set it up for you
landing.step1Body: FoodX is installed on your own domain and hosting, set up with your restaurant's name, menu and tables.
landing.step2Body: Log in with the account we hand over, complete a short setup, and enter your license key to activate.
landing.step3Body: Create staff accounts for your team by role and start taking orders the same day.
landing.why1Body: Your restaurant runs on its own setup. Your data belongs to you — it is never shared with other restaurants.
landing.why2Body: Billing, kitchen, stock, delivery and accounts live in one software — no juggling separate apps and notebooks.
landing.why3Body: Licenses, updates and support are managed centrally by FoodX, so your software stays current without effort.
landing.contactBody: Want FoodX for your restaurant, or a guided tour of the demo? Message us on WhatsApp or write to us:
landing.footerTagline: Restaurant management software — POS, kitchen, inventory, delivery and accounts in one place.
landing.footerDemoNote: The demo restaurant and its data are for demonstration only.
